COD.rationale: Content (red set), its organization (node grouping) and a separate origin/status entry are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to an identified content's organization or access.

C.rationale: Explicitly identifies colored content (red) with coordinate set for a current node.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is separately recorded for the identified content (distinguishing source/status from the content coordinates).

O.rationale: The content is presented as a grouped node (node n1) with an explicit set of coordinates, indicating organization/presentation structure.
